# Pesher Habakkuk Column 10 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 10 | **Condition:** Some damage; partially reconstructed

---

**10:1** "'Will not your creditors suddenly arise

**10:2** and those who make you tremble awake?

**10:3** You will become their spoil.

**10:4** Because you have plundered many nations,

**10:5** all the remnant of the peoples shall plunder you' (Hab 2:7-8a)."

**10:6** Its interpretation concerns the priest who rebelled

**10:7** [...] the statutes of [God...]

**10:8** and they mistreated him with acts of wicked

**10:9** vengeance, and inflicted on him horrible diseases

**10:10** and acts of revenge on his body of flesh.

**10:11** "'Because of the blood of men and the violence done to the land,

**10:12** the city, and all who dwell in it' (Hab 2:8b)."

**10:13** Its interpretation concerns the Wicked Priest whom,

**10:14** because of the wrong done to the Teacher of Righteousness

**10:15** and the men of his council, God delivered

**10:16** into the hand of his enemies to afflict him

**10:17** with a destroying blow in bitterness of soul, because he had acted wickedly against His chosen ones.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 10 covers Hab 2:7-8. This consensus translation harmonizes the best renderings from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. The pesher format — alternating biblical quotation and sectarian interpretation — is preserved throughout. Key sectarian titles maintained: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, Kittim, Spouter of the Lie. "Interpretation" for pesher (per LOGOS). Lacunae [...] are genuine manuscript gaps. See disagreement log for resolution details.*
